# Two shell nodes, not yet connected.
schema_version: 0
id: pair
metadata:
  layout:
    nodes:
      a: {x: 40, y: 40}
inputs: {}

nodes:

  a:
    type: shell
    config:
      command: "true"
    outputs:
      stdout: {type: string}

  b:
    type: shell
    config:
      command: "true"
    inputs:
      text: {type: string}

edges: []
outputs: {}

diagnostics.message: output "stdout" on node "a" is not consumed
diagnostics.suggestion: remove the output or bind it to an edge or graph output
